events.body: The electoral count continues while political correspondence becomes more concentrated around the expected announcement. The development is recorded within the existing campaign institutions and established relationships rather than as an unrelated occurrence. The people and organizations already attached to the thread continue their work under the arrangements established in earlier rounds. No unsupported office, ownership claim, future revenue, or additional manpower is created by the report. The associated records are preserved so the matter can continue to develop in later rounds. The result is therefore a concrete continuation of the established simulation rather than a forced historical outcome.
